objective: Determine whether target-only Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B can enter a voluntarily usable aggregate-nonresident P2 regime on the local RTX 3090 before material cache engineering.

ambition_contract.target_discontinuity: A real aggregate-nonresident 80B target with exact native execution, credible 32K prefill, and a trace-grounded implementable decode bound of at least 5 output tokens/s; 7-10 output tokens/s is strong product-vertical evidence.
ambition_contract.benchmark_role: The thin vertical is a decision gate, not the product goal.
ambition_contract.search_freedom: Local optimization, a minimal cache, and a separately scoped layer-major prefill redesign are allowed when trace evidence earns them.
ambition_contract.closure_standard: A valid implementable bound below 3 output tokens/s with no cheap material capability signal closes only this runtime, representation, and schedule. A chunk-major prefill cliff does not close a layer-major successor.

correctness.authority: Same-build synchronous-source control versus eight-window aligned O_DIRECT candidate using identical prompt tokens, greedy sampling, native Q4_K/Q6_K expert bytes, logits, generated tokens, route events, destination identities, and lifecycle.

prefill_32768_prompt.derivation: Four ordered byte-identical copies of the frozen heldout_code.txt fixture; the official chat template is applied once and the tokenized prompt is prospectively truncated to 32768 tokens. This is a prefill mechanics workload, not a semantic-quality workload.

estimands.source_bytes_per_output: Physical candidate source bytes during decode divided by committed target output tokens.
estimands.exposed_source_seconds_per_output: Candidate source-service exposed wait during decode divided by committed target output tokens.
estimands.compute_inclusive_favorable_rate: Committed target outputs divided by measured target compute plus the implementable-policy exposed source bound; oracle replay is reported separately.
estimands.prefill_rereads: Per-layer physical expert materializations after the first touch, reported by prompt point and microbatch shape.
estimands.resource_margin: Declared H or G minus complete-cgroup or physical-board candidate peak respectively.

continuation_rules.below_3_output_tokens_per_second: Close interactive P2 for the tested route unless one cheap capability discriminator shows material advantage.
continuation_rules.from_3_to_below_5: Run one cheap Qwen3-Next versus resident-Qwen3.6 capability discriminator before cache engineering.
continuation_rules.at_least_5: Implement only the smallest feasible policy that crossed if prefill remains credible.
continuation_rules.oracle_only: Treat predictive routing as a separate mechanism decision.
continuation_rules.at_least_7: Strong evidence to fund the product vertical.
continuation_rules.prefill_redirect: Stop chunk-major scaling when the trace-grounded favorable projection exceeds 180 seconds cold TTFT at 32K or the next cell budget; evaluate layer-major prefill as a separately named successor.

claim_boundary: This contract can establish target execution, exact source binding, routing, bounded prefill behavior, short decode economics, and offline cache-policy bounds at one local RTX 3090 identity. It cannot establish product admission, resident-comparator superiority, Stage 6 completion, broader hardware generality, or Qwen3-Next family rejection.
